status: closed native root prefixes and focused production parity passed; full CE15 acceptance pending

fingerprint.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted path + NUL + fileSHA256 + newline records

implemented.partition: One shared executor partition preserves drawVectors priority, maximal vector/solid batches, one-item original draws and unbatched linear-sRGB. Prefixes end only at these actual boundaries; no new isolated draw or alpha composite is introduced.
implemented.closure: A conservative authored selection hint rejects keyed parents/scopes and known dependencies. It never authorizes reuse: complete evaluated prepared-content/backdrop graphs, export/backend/encoding/native target policy and ordered visibility phases are checked on every use. A provider with fixed authored params but changing actual visual keys falls back.
implemented.ownership: A selected prefix paints once globally in its original target, publishes exact native bytes, and is restored before the original suffix. Full root seeding consumes an already prepared prefix instead of repainting it. Prefix and root entries share the same existing local admission limit and failure path; hooks are restored on disposal.
implemented.statistics: Actual phase and ordered operation identities accompany paint, restore, copy, fallback and native paint/readback/submission spans. These are closure statistics, not complete per-layer GPU time or total allocation.
implemented.browser: 48 cases across Canvas/WebGL, software/default raster, opaque/transparent targets and six variants: closed, mixed batch, changing upstream backdrop, late prefix, changing provider and linear-sRGB. All 2,496 prefix comparisons are exact on fresh/reverse/repeated reads. The actual static provider paints once globally wherever an original closed boundary exists. A mixed WebGL vector batch stays intact, and changing closures keep original painting. Previous native root/source/independent/failure proofs still pass in the expanded 104-case command.
implemented.production: Eight direct native-glyph/rich-provider prefixes under actual moving image pixels, both backends/raster policies and late visibility. All 32 uncached/one/four/repeated exports retain complete encoded PNG bodies and every decoded frame. Actual global prefix ownership/restore counts, ordered operations, source store totals and worker lifecycle agree.
